providers.service_territory: Most of western and central Montana including Billings, Great Falls, Bozeman, Helena, Missoula; ~375,000 electric customers statewide
providers.notes: Largest IOU in Montana. Rates regulated by Montana Public Service Commission (MPSC). November 2025 rate case order increased base electric rates ~17% effective February 1, 2026. Operates branded E+ (Efficiency Plus) suite of commercial programs.

providers.service_territory: Eastern Montana — Glendive, Sidney, Miles City, Wolf Point, and surrounding communities
providers.notes: Part of MDU Resources Group. Rates regulated by MPSC for Montana operations. Large customers (as defined by MCA 69-8-103(15)) are ineligible for USB-funded incentive programs. Issues rebate payments by check within 4–6 weeks.

providers.service_territory: Flathead Valley and northwest Montana including Kalispell, Whitefish, Columbia Falls, and Libby areas
providers.notes: Large member-owned cooperative. Partners with Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) on commercial lighting rebate programs. All rebates subject to post-installation inspection. An overall 5.5% rate increase took effect June 1, 2026.

providers.service_territory: Rural Missoula County and surrounding areas outside NorthWestern Energy's service territory
providers.notes: Member-owned cooperative serving rural Missoula County. Offers rebates for heat pumps, water heaters, insulation and weatherization, and Energy Star appliances. Residential and commercial programs available.

providers.service_territory: Rural Yellowstone County and surrounding eastern Montana areas near Billings
providers.notes: Member-owned cooperative. Offers residential and commercial rebates for heat pumps (add-on and geothermal), water heaters, dishwashers, dryers, and refrigerators. Commercial lighting and HVAC rebates available to members.

providers.service_territory: Southwest Montana including Dillon, Beaverhead, Madison, and Jefferson counties
providers.notes: One of the larger cooperatives in southwest Montana. Co-op members should confirm current rebate calendar and availability directly. Listed among co-ops with active energy efficiency programs.

providers.service_territory: Northern Montana including Cut Bank, Shelby, Conrad, and Glacier County areas
providers.notes: Member-owned cooperative serving north-central Montana. Participates in statewide co-op efficiency programs. Commercial rebate availability should be confirmed directly with the cooperative.

programs.stacking_rules: Customers encouraged to seek additional state and federal tax credits
programs.funding_status: Open — funding limited and program subject to change without notice
programs.program_notes_ai: Covers lighting, heating, irrigation equipment, VFDs, refrigeration, air conditioning, appliances, and water heating. Program guidelines and rebate amounts are published in the downloadable application PDF. Funding provided through NorthWestern Energy electric supply rates. DSIRE-listed program valid through June 30, 2025 cycle; confirm renewal status for FY2026. Program contractors are available as a resource but not required.

programs.program_name: E+ Business Partners Program — Electric Custom Incentives (2025)
programs.program_notes_ai: Custom incentive track for cost-effective electric measures or projects in new or existing facilities. Pre-approval required before project commencement. Offered to commercial, institutional, industrial, agricultural, and multifamily facilities. Works alongside the prescriptive E+ Commercial Electric Rebate track.

Dedicated lighting track listed separately from the main commercial electric rebate program. Covers fixture and bulb replacements with more efficient alternatives. Listed on the NorthWestern Energy rebates page alongside the Business Partners and Irrigation programs.

Dedicated irrigation custom incentive track helping irrigators become more energy-efficient through technical assistance and financial incentives. Listed alongside Business Partners Program on rebates page. Primarily serves agricultural customers with pump system upgrades.

Incentivizes high-efficiency electric motor rewinds. Listed explicitly on NorthWestern Energy's rebates and incentives page as a distinct commercial program track. Targeted at businesses and agricultural operations with significant motor loads.

required_documents: Montana Commercial Lighting Rebate Application Form
Supporting material (brand, model, serial number, installation date, dealer info)
programs.program_notes_ai: Pre-approval required for all projects over $1,000. Submit application and check the pre-approval box before commencing work to secure funding. MTD responds in writing once approved. Must be an active Montana-Dakota electric account holder in Montana. Large customers under MCA 69-8-103(15) are ineligible. Funded via Universal System Benefits (USB) program. Invoices with brand, model, serial number, installation date, and dealer info required.

required_documents: Electric Commercial Partnership Program application form
programs.program_notes_ai: For commercial projects that will result in significant electric energy savings. Project must be submitted for pre-approval before work begins. MDU calculates the rebate based on amount of energy savings and project economics. Measurement and verification of estimated energy savings may be required, and rebate payments may be reduced based on actual verified savings. Large customers (MCA 69-8-103(15)) are ineligible. USB-funded.

Program offered in conjunction with Bonneville Power Administration (BPA). Rebate is the lesser of 70% of actual project cost or per-fixture rebate total calculated on Lighting Rebate Verification Reports. Must be pre-approved by Flathead Electric prior to installation. All rebates subject to post-installation inspection by Flathead Electric to ensure proper installation.

required_documents: New Construction Lighting Rebate Verification Report
programs.program_notes_ai: New construction track of the BPA-partnered commercial lighting program. Distinct verification report required vs. the retrofit program. Rebate capped at lesser of 70% of project cost or per-fixture calculated total. Pre-approval and post-installation inspection required.

programs.program_name: Commercial Heat Pump & Equipment Rebate Program (2025)
programs.program_notes_ai: YVEC offers rebates to residential and commercial members for add-on heat pumps, geothermal heat pumps, water heaters, dishwashers, dryers, and refrigerators. Commercial lighting rebates also available. Geothermal heat pump rebate $200/ton up to $800 commercial; residential up to $1,000. Confirm current commercial rebate schedule directly with YVEC.

rate_schedules.description: Standard residential electric service in Montana. All-in rate approximately $0.143/kWh as of late 2025 per MT PSC rate summary; base rates increased ~17% effective February 2026 following November 2025 rate case order.
rate_schedules.notes: Rate includes both delivery (base) and supply (PCCAM) components. Supply rate adjusts quarterly. $4.20/month service charge per MT PSC December 2025 rate summary.

rate_schedules.schedule_name: Schedule GSEDS-1 — General Service Electric Demand (Small)
rate_schedules.description: Demand-metered schedule for small commercial customers. Combines monthly service charge, per-kWh energy charge, and per-kW demand charge. Exact cents-per-kWh and per-kW figures published in Montana GSEDS-1 tariff sheets filed with MPSC.
rate_schedules.notes: Exact C&I rate components are published in the Montana tariff book; confirmed GSEDS demand-metered schedule structure post November 2025 rate case order (effective Feb 1, 2026). Retrieve current figures from northwesternenergy.com/billing-payment/rates-tariffs/rates-tariffs-montana.

rate_schedules.schedule_name: Schedule GSEDS-2 — General Service Electric Demand (Medium/Large)
rate_schedules.description: Demand-metered schedule for medium-to-large commercial and industrial customers. Combines monthly service charge, per-kWh energy charge, and per-kW demand charge. Demand charge often dominates larger C&I bills.
rate_schedules.notes: Exact GSEDS-2 per-kWh and per-kW figures are published in the Montana tariff book and are updated per MPSC orders. Also subject to USBC Rider ($0.001143/kWh for loads under 1,000 kW). BPA residential exchange credit does not apply to commercial accounts.

rate_schedules.description: Time-of-use rate option for eligible large commercial and industrial customers. Supply rate adjusts quarterly through PCCAM mechanism. Exact on-peak/off-peak rates available in MPSC-approved Montana tariff book.
rate_schedules.notes: NorthWestern Energy rates are set by MPSC and include supply recovered via the Power Costs and Credit Adjustment Mechanism (PCCAM). C&I demand-metered schedules adjusted following November 2025 rate case order effective February 1, 2026.

rate_schedules.schedule_name: Schedule QF-1 — Qualifying Facility / Special Contract
rate_schedules.description: Qualifying Facility interconnection or special contract rate filed with MPSC. Applicable to co-generation and small power production facilities under PURPA.
rate_schedules.notes: Direct PDF tariff document available on NorthWestern Energy docs library. Rate details contained within the filed tariff document.

rate_schedules.description: Standard residential electric service in MDU's eastern Montana service territory. Rate approximately $0.092/kWh per 2022 MT PSC rate summary (service charge $0.19/day = ~$5.70/month). Confirm current rate with MDU directly.
rate_schedules.notes: Based on 2022 MT PSC Gas and Electric Rate Summary showing MDU Electric at ~$0.091–0.110/kWh depending on month. Current tariff sheets on file with MPSC at montana-dakota.com/rates-services/rates-tariffs/. Distinct from NorthWestern Energy tariffs.

rate_schedules.description: Commercial electric service rate for MDU's Montana customers. Tariffs and riders are distinct from NorthWestern Energy's service territory. Current rate schedules available via MPSC-approved tariff filings.
rate_schedules.notes: MDU is part of MDU Resources Group. Its Montana tariffs are regulated by the Montana PSC. Specific kWh rate and demand charge figures must be retrieved from current MPSC-approved tariff sheets at montana-dakota.com/rates-services/rates-tariffs/.

rate_schedules.description: Standard residential electric service. Basic charge $26.66/month for single-phase service. Rate 9.66¢/kWh, reflecting 5.5% rate increase effective June 1, 2026 due to rising wholesale power and operational costs.
rate_schedules.notes: Flathead Electric's residential rate falls below the Montana state average. PDF of Residential Service Rates available at flatheadelectric.com. Rate includes all residential services per the published rate schedule.

rate_schedules.description: Commercial electric service for Flathead Electric Cooperative members. Rate schedule available as PDF on cooperative website. 5.5% rate increase took effect June 1, 2026.
rate_schedules.notes: Exact commercial kWh and demand charge rates require retrieval from Flathead Electric's published commercial rate schedule PDF at flatheadelectric.com/my-account-bill/rates-service-fees/.

forms.form_name: Montana E+ Commercial Electric Rebate Program Guidelines and Application
forms.form_notes: Main combined program guidelines and application for the E+ Commercial Electric Rebate Program. Contains equipment types, rebate amounts, instructions, and submission requirements.

forms.program_name: E+ Business Partners Program — Electric Custom Incentives (2025)
forms.form_notes: Custom project application for the Business Partners Program. Must be submitted for pre-approval before project commencement. Specific form PDF linked from the commercial electric rebates page.

forms.program_name: E+ Commercial Natural Gas Savings Program (2025)
forms.form_name: Commercial Natural Gas Savings Program Guidelines and Application
forms.form_notes: Download the Program Guidelines and Application from the commercial natural gas rebates page and follow instructions on the form. Equipment types and rebate amounts detailed in the combined guidelines/application document.

forms.form_name: Montana Commercial Lighting Rebate Application Form
forms.form_notes: Check the pre-approval box for projects over $1,000. Submit prior to commencing work. Include contractor invoices and supporting material (brand, model, serial number, installation date, dealer info). Linked as PDF from the MDU savings for business page.

forms.form_name: Electric Commercial Partnership Program Application Form
forms.form_notes: Terms and conditions of the program are listed on page two of the form. Pre-approval required before commencing work. Linked as PDF from the MDU savings for business page.

forms.form_name: Commercial Lighting Retrofit Rebate Verification Report
forms.form_notes: Rebate verification report required for the retrofit program. Per-fixture rebate totals are calculated on this form. Must be pre-approved before installation. Available from Flathead Electric savings and rebates page.

forms.form_name: New Construction Lighting Rebate Verification Report
forms.form_notes: Distinct verification report for the new construction lighting track (separate from the retrofit form). Must be pre-approved prior to installation. Available from Flathead Electric savings and rebates page.
